fixed_task.input_cutoff_rule: An input may be used only if both its event time and its availability time are at or before origin time t.
fixed_task.subject_rule: Use protocol_b_group from primary split_scope_v1; normalize val to validation only.
fixed_task.support_rule: The entire closed [history_start_time, target_time] must be in one temporal partition. Origins alone never determine admission.
fixed_task.preprocessing_policy: Fit learned preprocessing separately on the appropriate training split of each protocol. Validation is for tuning and test is for frozen evaluation only.
fixed_task.unseen_history_policy: An unseen subject may supply causally available pre-origin history at prediction time. Only training subjects fit models, preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, and feature selection. Validation may guide model selection; test-subject windows, statistics, and history cannot guide fitting or tuning.
fixed_task.cross_protocol_policy: Do not transfer learned statistics or choices from Protocol A data into Protocol B when those subjects are held out in Protocol B; shared exploration remains restricted to the common training range.
